sentences.text: Here’s that bearing trap worked out.
You’re steering zero four five by compass, and your deviation card shows two degrees west on that heading.
You take a compass bearing on a lighthouse and read one two zero.
Use the deviation for your heading, two west, not the deviation for one two zero.
Correcting toward true, subtract west: one two zero minus two is one one eight magnetic, and one one eight minus five is one one three true.
Bearings are always plotted on the chart as true, so you’d plot one one three.
